name: Magic UI
licence: MIT (github.com/magicuidesign/magicui LICENSE.md). Magic UI Pro templates commercial (not studied).
bestFor: one deliberate motion moment on a launch page (number ticker for a real metric, marquee for real logos)
device mockups (Safari, iPhone, Android) to frame real product screenshots
avoidFor: any page wanting to avoid the 2023-25 'AI startup' look (border beams, shimmer buttons, aurora text, grid backgrounds)
stacking more than one ambient effect per viewport

typography.notes: Text effects animate the project's type (Text Animate by word/character/line, Hyper Text scramble, Word Rotate, Typing Animation, Aurora/Animated Gradient text, Sparkles, Morphing, Spinning, Kinetic weight, 3D flip). No scale of its own.

color.darkMode: Mostly designed on black; colours hard-coded in props
color.contrastNotes: Gradient and shimmer text often lowers contrast below AA mid-animation; not addressed in the sampled sources.

shadows: glows and neon-gradient cards rather than shadows
depth.blur: blur-fade uses 6px blur on entry; progressive-blur; backlight glow

easings: springs: text-animate stiffness 300 damping 15; magic-card 250-300 / 30-35; number-ticker stiffness 100 damping 60
linear infinite loops (marquee 40s, border beam 6s, shimmer 3s alternate)
motion.notes: Defaults: BlurFade duration 0.4s, offset 6px, blur 6px, direction down, inViewMargin -50px. TextAnimate duration 0.3s, by word, fadeIn, startOnView true. Marquee --duration 40s, --gap 1rem, repeat 4, pauseOnHover false. BorderBeam duration 6s, size 50. ShimmerButton shimmerDuration 3s, shimmerSize 0.05em. Particles quantity 100. No prefers-reduced-motion handling found in the 8 registry sources sampled.

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Low: effects, not controls. Hover is the main state; focus/disabled rarely styled; reduced motion not handled in sampled sources.

tokenArchitecture: None: props with hex defaults + a few Tailwind theme keyframes (animate-marquee, animate-shimmer-slide, animate-spin-around) added via registry cssVars.
distinctiveness: Low now: these exact effects became the visual signature of 2023-25 AI/dev-tool launch pages.
weaknesses: Effects read as AI cliché (see cliché list in the knowledge note)
No reduced-motion handling in sampled components
Infinite loops cost battery and distract
takeaways: Standard entrance values worth keeping: 0.3-0.4s, 6px offset, 6px blur, spring 300/15 for text.
Marquee only with real logos, slow (40s), pause on hover, and a reduced-motion static fallback.
Number Ticker is honest motion only when the number is real and sourced.
